note: End-to-end paths through this case. Reachability is a weak claim: the validator says a phase can be reached, these say a plausible sequence of clinical actions gets there. Cover the intended path, every harmful halt, every blocked prerequisite, the deterioration branch and its rescue, and any ordering a resident is likely to produce.

scenarios.name: Prerequisite blocking: infusion and intubation attempted out of sequence
Sublingual nitrate as the bridge still advances the phase
Harmful: intravenous metoprolol for the compensatory tachycardia
Harmful: dobutamine while warm and hypertensive
Deterioration and rescue: early intubation, then correct management
Deterioration mismanaged: fluid bolus for post-intubation hypotension
Restarting the nitrate after vasopressor rescue is harmful
Diuretic given before positive pressure still reaches stabilizing
